### CVE-2023-0014 — Capture-replay vulnerability in SAP NetWeaver AS for ABAP and ABAP Platform
- Assigner: sap | Published: 2023-01-10 | Updated: 2025-04-09 | Max CVSS: 9
- CWE: CWE-294 CWE-294 Authentication Bypass by Capture-replay
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 9 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

SAP NetWeaver ABAP Server and ABAP Platform - versions SAP_BASIS 700, 701, 702, 710, 711, 730, 731, 740, 750, 751, 752, 753, 754, 755, 756, 757, KERNEL 7.22, 7.53, 7.77, 7.81, 7.85, 7.89, KRNL64UC 7.22, 7.22EXT, 7.53, KRNL64NUC 7.22, 7.22EXT, creates information about system identity in an ambiguous format. This could lead to capture-replay vulnerability and may be exploited by malicious users to obtain illegitimate access to the system.




Affected:
- SAP / NetWeaver ABAP Server and ABAP Platform: affected SAP_BASIS 701; affected SAP_BASIS 702; affected SAP_BASIS 710; affected SAP_BASIS 711; affected SAP_BASIS 730; affected SAP_BASIS 731; affected SAP_BASIS 740; affected SAP_BASIS 750; affected SAP_BASIS 751; affected SAP_BASIS 752; affected SAP_BASIS 753; affected SAP_BASIS 754; affected SAP_BASIS 755; affected SAP_BASIS 756; affected SAP_BASIS 757 …(+11 more in JSONL)

- https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/3089413
- https://www.sap.com/documents/2022/02/fa865ea4-167e-0010-bca6-c68f7e60039b.html

### CVE-2023-0017 — Improper access control in SAP NetWeaver AS for Java
- Assigner: sap | Published: 2023-01-10 | Updated: 2025-04-09 | Max CVSS: 9.4
- CWE: CWE-284 CWE-284 Improper access control
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 9.4 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:L`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=partial

An unauthenticated attacker in SAP NetWeaver AS for Java - version 7.50, due to improper access control, can attach to an open interface and make use of an open naming and directory API to access services which can be used to perform unauthorized operations affecting users and data on the current system. This could allow the attacker to have full read access to user data, make modifications to user data, and make services within the system unavailable.

Affected:
- SAP / NetWeaver AS for Java: affected 7.50

References:
- https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/3268093
- https://www.sap.com/documents/2022/02/fa865ea4-167e-0010-bca6-c68f7e60039b.html

### CVE-2023-0018 — Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability in SAP BusinessObjects Business Intelligence Platform (Central management console)
- Assigner: sap | Published: 2023-01-10 | Updated: 2025-04-09 | Max CVSS: 10
- CWE: CWE-79 CWE-79 Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 10 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=total

Due to improper input sanitization of user-controlled input in SAP BusinessObjects Business Intelligence Platform CMC application - versions 420, and 430, an attacker with basic user-level privileges can modify/upload crystal reports containing a malicious payload. Once these reports are viewable, anyone who opens those reports would be susceptible to stored XSS attacks. As a result of the attack, information maintained in the victim's web browser can be read, modified, and sent to the attacker.

Affected:
- SAP / BusinessObjects Business Intelligence Platform (Central management console): affected 420; affected 430

References:
- https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/3266006
- https://www.sap.com/documents/2022/02/fa865ea4-167e-0010-bca6-c68f7e60039b.html

### CVE-2023-2827 — Missing Authentication in SAP Plant Connectivity and Production Connector for SAP Digital
- Assigner: sap | Published: 2023-06-13 | Updated: 2025-01-03 | Max CVSS: 7.9
- CWE: CWE-306 CWE-306: Missing Authentication for Critical Function
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.9 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:A/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:C/C:L/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=partial

SAP Plant Connectivity - version 15.5 (PCo) or the Production Connector for SAP Digital Manufacturing - version 1.0, do not validate the signature of the JSON Web Token (JWT) in the HTTP request sent from SAP Digital Manufacturing. Therefore, unauthorized callers from the internal network could send service requests to PCo or the Production Connector, which could have an impact on the integrity of the integration with SAP Digital Manufacturing.



Affected:
- SAP_SE / SAP Plant Connectivity: affected 1.0

References:
- https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/3301942
- https://www.sap.com/documents/2022/02/fa865ea4-167e-0010-bca6-c68f7e60039b.html

### CVE-2023-42472 — Insufficient File type validation in SAP BusinessObjects Business Intelligence Platform (Web Intelligence HTML interface)
- Assigner: sap | Published: 2023-09-12 | Updated: 2024-09-26 | Max CVSS: 8.7
- CWE: CWE-434 CWE-434: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 8.7 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:R/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

Due to insufficient file type validation, SAP BusinessObjects Business Intelligence Platform (Web Intelligence HTML interface) - version 420, allows a report creator to upload files from local system into the report over the network. When uploading the image file, an authenticated attacker could intercept the request, modify the content type and the extension to read and modify sensitive data causing a high impact on confidentiality and integrity of the application.



Affected:
- SAP_SE / SAP BusinessObjects Business Intelligence Platform (Web Intelligence HTML interface): affected 420

References:
- https://me.sap.com/notes/3370490

### CVE-2023-42481 — Improper Access Control vulnerability in SAP Commerce Cloud
- Assigner: sap | Published: 2023-12-12 | Updated: 2024-09-28 | Max CVSS: 8.1
- CWE: CWE-640 CWE-640: Weak Password Recovery Mechanism for Forgotten Password
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 8.1 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:N`

In SAP Commerce Cloud - versions HY_COM 1905, HY_COM 2005, HY_COM2105, HY_COM 2011, HY_COM 2205, COM_CLOUD 2211, a locked B2B user can misuse the forgotten password functionality to un-block his user account again and re-gain access if SAP Commerce Cloud - Composable Storefront is used as storefront, due to weak access controls in place. This leads to a considerable impact on confidentiality and integrity.

Affected:
- SAP_SE / SAP Commerce Cloud: affected HY_COM 1905; affected HY_COM 2005; affected HY_COM2105; affected HY_COM 2011; affected HY_COM 2205; affected COM_CLOUD 2211

SAP GUI for Windows and SAP GUI for Java - versions SAP_BASIS 755, SAP_BASIS 756, SAP_BASIS 757, SAP_BASIS 758, allow an unauthenticated attacker to access information which would otherwise be restricted and confidential.
